comment: The questions no dataset in this repo can answer, written by hand.
Everything else in the bank is derived and cannot rot. These can, so the rule is strict: the
answer must not be something a newspaper could make wrong. A fact of history, geography or
spelling qualifies as it is. A fact that moves - who holds an office, which religion or economy
is biggest, what a currency is - qualifies only when the question names the year it was true
("Who was president of Portugal in 2020?"), because then the answer is history and nothing
has to be revisited when the news changes. Never "who is", always "who was ... in <year>".
`subject` is the country code the question is about, which is what the leaderboard weighting
draws on; leave it out for a question about nowhere in particular. It never reaches a player
before they answer, so it does not matter that it gives the answer away here -
`extra:russia-timezones` is about `ru` and the answer is Russia, and that is fine.
`wrong` carries five, of which a round shows two. A player has eight seconds, so keep the
question short enough to read in three.
